INDIA_DPDP_2023.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India)
INDIA_DPDP_2023.primarySection: Section 12(3) - Right to Correction and Erasure of Personal Data
INDIA_DPDP_2023.exceptionsSection: Section 17 - Exemptions for legal compliance, statutory obligations & legal claims
INDIA_DPDP_2023.retentionPolicy: Data must be erased immediately upon withdrawal of consent, unless retention is mandated by law.

MARKETING_PII.legalBasis: DPDP Sec. 12(3) - Consent withdrawn, no statutory obligation to retain.

CUSTOMER_PROFILE.legalBasis: DPDP Sec. 12(3) - In-place pseudonymization or erasure of contact identifiers.

INDIA_BANKING_RBI_PMLA.title: RBI Master Direction - KYC (2016) & Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002
INDIA_BANKING_RBI_PMLA.primarySection: PMLA Section 12(1) & RBI Master Direction Sec. 38 - Maintenance of Records
INDIA_BANKING_RBI_PMLA.triggerEvent: 5 years after cessation of business relationship (account closure)
INDIA_BANKING_RBI_PMLA.retentionPolicy: Mandatory statutory retention of customer identification data, KYC records, and account files for 5 years.

BANKING_KYC.legalBasis: RBI Master Direction KYC Sec. 38 & PMLA Sec. 12 - Mandatory 5-year post-closure retention.

ACCOUNT_AUDIT_LOGS.legalBasis: Banking Regulation Act Sec. 45Y & PMLA 2002 - Anti-money laundering audit trail protection.

INDIA_TAX_GST_INCOME_TAX.title: Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act 2017 & Income Tax Act 1961
INDIA_TAX_GST_INCOME_TAX.primarySection: CGST Act Section 36 & Income Tax Act Section 44AA / 285BA
INDIA_TAX_GST_INCOME_TAX.retentionPolicy: Mandatory retention of books of account, invoices, vouchers, and tax invoices for a period of 72 months (6-7 financial years).

FINANCIAL_INVOICE_LEDGER.legalBasis: CGST Act 2017 Sec. 36 & Income Tax Sec. 44AA - 7-year statutory financial invoice retention.

PAYMENT_TRANSACTIONS.legalBasis: Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007 & GST Act Sec. 36 - Statutory financial trail.

EU_GDPR.title: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679
EU_GDPR.primarySection: Article 17(1) - Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten')
EU_GDPR.exceptionsSection: Article 17(3)(b) & Article 17(3)(e) - Compliance with legal obligation & defense of legal claims
EU_GDPR.maxPenalty: €20 Million or 4% of Global Annual Turnover

MARKETING_PII.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 17(1)(b) - Withdrawal of consent where no other legal ground applies.

CONTRACTUAL_OBLIGATION.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 17(3)(e) - Establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.
